profile_text.body:
Pegasystems Inc is a public company headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker PEGA and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001013857. On its own website the company describes itself as an AI-powered platform for enterprise transformation, saying it has worked since 1983 with large organizations to automate workflows, personalize customer experiences, and modernize legacy systems.

Pega describes its AI as grounded in best practices with governance built in, and says its AI agents operate with context, compliance, and human oversight so customers can orchestrate an agentic workforce end to end. It names Pega Platform as the product that unifies AI for mission-critical work and Pega Blueprint as an AI-powered workspace that brings business and IT together at design time. The company positions its architecture as the basis for scale and continuous adaptation in governed, mission-critical operations.

The company's legal exposure is recorded in Massachusetts, with 191 cases. No individual products, MCP servers, or specific lawsuits are listed for it.
